title: Best Video Marketing Agencies in the US (2026)
summary: US video marketing agencies grouped by job: paid social video ads, brand films and YouTube. Published prices, locations and who runs distribution. Nov 2026.
body_markdown:
## Which agencies make brand films and commercials?


Some briefs call for one commercial or brand film built to last, rather than a weekly flow of test ads. These three work by project.


### Harmon Brothers


As of November 2026, Harmon Brothers, based in Provo, Utah, calls itself the original viral video ad agency and is known for ads for Squatty Potty, Purple and Lume. It says it creates ads that build the brand and sell at the same time, and it mainly works with ecommerce companies. It does not publish prices or say whether it buys media; its[work with us page](https://harmonbrothers.com/work-with-us/) starts with an application.


**Best for** an ecommerce brand that wants one standout ad to carry a campaign.


### Sandwich


As of November 2026, Sandwich is a Los Angeles studio that makes commercials, TV spots, launch films, explainers and animation, mostly for technology companies such as Slack, Airbnb and Square. Its FAQ says $250K is typically a good starting point, and that it may take equity from some startups. It does not publish media buying.


**Best for** a technology company with a large budget that wants a polished commercial or launch film.


### Demo Duck


As of November 2026, Demo Duck is a Chicago studio that makes explainer, commercial, brand, testimonial and company story videos, plus TV spots, in animation, live action and mixed media. Its site says a custom 2D animated video typically runs $20,000 to $25,000, testimonials and company stories $15,000 to $20,000, and scripted live action $40,000 to $60,000 or more. It works with clients from startups to Fortune 500 companies, and does not publish media buying.


**Best for** a team that wants one well-crafted explainer or brand video at a published price range.


## Which agencies run YouTube and organic video?


If the goal is a channel that grows week after week, these agencies plan, produce and publish the videos and can promote them.


### Single Grain


As of November 2026, Single Grain's YouTube channel management service covers channel strategy and branding, scripting, filming coordination and editing, Shorts cut from long videos, YouTube SEO and thumbnails, community management, analytics and paid promotion through YouTube ad campaigns. It describes itself as remote-first and does not publish prices; the service page is aimed at brands with 100,000 or more views a month.


**Best for** a brand with an existing YouTube audience that wants the whole channel run for it.


### NoGood


As of November 2026, NoGood, headquartered in New York with hubs in Miami and Dubai, runs organic social programs that include YouTube Shorts and long-form video, TikTok and Instagram Reels, with 20 to 30 pieces of platform-native content a month. Its[video marketing page](https://nogood.io/video-marketing-services/) lists scripting, studio and on-location shoots, editing, motion graphics, UGC and video SEO, and it offers paid amplification of organic winners. Prices are not published.


**Best for** a startup or larger brand that wants a steady stream of social video across several platforms.


### Brafton


As of November 2026, Brafton's YouTube marketing service covers video creation from Shorts to full-length tutorials, YouTube SEO, description copywriting, distribution, YouTube ads and channel management. It says a single explainer might start around $3,000, and an always-on program with monthly production, channel management and paid promotion can range from $5,000 to $20,000 or more a month. Its[about page](https://www.brafton.com/about/) lists US offices in Boston and Chicago. Brafton is a broad content marketing agency, not only a video studio.


**Best for** a team that wants YouTube video, SEO and promotion handled together at a published price range.


## How much do video marketing agencies cost?


From the published figures, checked November 13, 2026:


- **Monthly programs:** Knowlify starts at $5,000 a month for video ads; Chamber Media suggests about $5K to $10K a month at minimum for creative, strategy and management; Brafton's always-on YouTube programs run $5,000 to $20,000 or more a month.
- **Per video:** Brafton's explainers start around $3,000; Demo Duck's custom videos run $15,000 to $60,000 or more depending on the type.
- **Large productions:** Sandwich says $250K is typically a good starting point.
- **Performance terms:** TubeScience ties its fee to ad performance instead of a fixed price.


The others quote privately. Ask each agency whether media spend is included. For what drives video ad prices, see our[video ad production cost guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/video-ad-production-cost) .


## What should you ask a video marketing agency before signing?


- **The job.** Is this agency built for ads that need testing, a single brand film, or a channel that publishes every week?
- **Distribution.** Who uploads, runs and pays for the media, and in whose ad account?
- **Volume.** How many finished videos arrive each month, and how many are new ideas rather than cutdowns?
- **Ownership.** Who owns the footage, edits and any creators' usage rights?
- **Terms.** What is the minimum commitment, and is there a paid first project?


## When is Knowlify not the right fit?


Choose another agency if:


- **You need real people on camera.** Our UGC-style ads use AI presenters; for creators, see inBeat or our[UGC agency comparison](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-ugc-agencies) .
- **You need one commercial or brand film.** We work in weekly batches of about 25 ads, so a single film fits Sandwich, Demo Duck or Harmon Brothers.
- **You want a YouTube channel grown.** Single Grain, NoGood and Brafton run channels; we make paid ads for Facebook and Instagram.
- **Your main channels are not Facebook and Instagram.** Chamber Media and inBeat publish media buying across more networks.


## Key takeaways


- Decide the job first: paid social ads, a brand film or a YouTube program. The agencies in each group work very differently.
- Our top pick for paid social video is Knowlify, with weekly AI video ads from $5,000 a month and optional Meta campaign management.
- Published prices range from about $3,000 for one explainer to $250K for a large commercial, so compare the unit each price buys.
- Ask who runs and pays for distribution before you compare fees.


## FAQ


### What does a video marketing agency do?


It plans, scripts, produces and edits video for a brand. Some also distribute it, by running paid ads or managing a YouTube channel, while others deliver files only.


### How much does a video marketing agency cost in the US?


As of November 2026, published figures in this guide range from about $3,000 for a single explainer at Brafton to a typical $250K starting point at Sandwich. Monthly programs for ads or YouTube run from about $5,000 a month. Ask whether media spend is included.


### Do video marketing agencies run the ads?


Some do. Chamber Media, TubeScience, inBeat, NoGood, Single Grain and Brafton publish media buying or paid promotion, and Knowlify offers Meta campaign management. Sandwich, Demo Duck and Harmon Brothers do not publish media buying.


### Is Knowlify a video marketing agency?


Knowlify is a video ad agency: it makes AI video ads for Facebook and Instagram and can run the campaigns. It does not make brand films or manage YouTube channels.
